$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\varphi(x+y)+x\varphi'(x+y)+y\varphi'(x+y),\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\phi(x+y)+x\phi'(x+y)+y\phi'(x+y)$

$\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}=2\varphi'(x+y)+x\varphi''(x+y)+y\varphi''(x+y)\quad \frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}=2\phi'(x+y)+x\phi''(x+y)+y\phi''(x+y)$

$\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y}=\varphi'(x+y)+\phi'(x+y)+x\varphi''(x+y)+y\varphi''(x+y)$

比较上述三式易见：$\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}-2\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}=0$
